name: sidebar-01
title: Sidebar 01
description: A simple sidebar with the navigation grouped by section: an order pad hung from a binder clip, an edition switcher and a search box on top, the current page in highlighter with a bracket in the margin. Mirrors shadcn's sidebar-01. Looks right on the desk and on plain paper.

files.content: import * as React from "react" import { docsNav, docsVersions } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-data" import { SearchForm } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-search-form" import { VersionSwitcher } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-version-switcher" import { Sidebar, SidebarContent, SidebarGroup, SidebarGroupContent, SidebarGroupLabel, SidebarHeader, SidebarMenu, SidebarMenuButton, SidebarMenuItem, SidebarRail, } from "@/components/ui/sidebar" export function AppSidebar({ ...props }: React.ComponentProps) { return ( {docsNav.map((section) => ( {section.title} {section.items.map((item) => ( {item.title} ))} ))} ) }

import { AppSidebar } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-01/components/sidebar-01-app-sidebar"
import { containedClasses } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-contained"
import { docsTrail } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-data"
import { PageBody, PageHeader, PageNote, PageSheet } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-page"
import { SidebarProvider } from "@/components/ui/sidebar"

export default function Page({ contained = false }: { contained?: boolean }) {
  const c = containedClasses(contained)
  return (
    <SidebarProvider className={c.provider}>
      <AppSidebar className={c.sidebar} />
      <PageSheet className={c.inset}>
        <PageHeader crumbs={docsTrail} bordered className="overflow-x-clip" />
        <PageBody title="Margins" kicker="Writing on paper">
          <PageNote title="The margin is empty" pose="write">
            Nothing scribbled here yet. Pick another page from the pad, or grab a pencil and start one.
          </PageNote>
        </PageBody>
      </PageSheet>
    </SidebarProvider>
  )
}
